question: The interface vocabulary has no token for the SMTP relay / SMTP submission protocol used by transactional senders such as SMTP.com; interface is recorded as rest with the relay named in interface_detail. Should a 'smtp' token be added to the interface enum?
why: SMTP.com exposes a documented SMTP relay plus a REST API; the closed interface enum cannot express the SMTP relay, so the record uses rest and names the relay in prose without forcing a wrong term.

new.slice: The interface vocabulary has no token for the SMTP relay / SMTP submission proto
